events.caption: Helicase opens parental DNA; the leading 3-prime end grows toward the fork

scientific_simplifications: Schematic, not molecular structure or scale. One local fork, no chromosome-end/telomerase claim.
Primase/Pol alpha label abstracts RNA initiation and short DNA handoff; individual RNaseH/FEN1 steps omitted.
Show one local primer maturation only; other orange primers remain, final caption must not claim all replication completed.
Parent fork is camera-fixed; synthesis stays on its opened left side. Pol epsilon is the common undisturbed leading-strand teaching model, not an absolute exclusion of Pol delta.
Direction constraint is derived from verified5to3/antiparallel facts plus displayed template endpoints, not a universal sign of x.
